title: Jump on Buildings
source_text: Our well known coding mafia went to the city. *Farzi Coder* is the boss here. He hired a new member named *Lambu Keyboard* in his gang. *Farzi Coder* is so smart (at least that's what he thinks), so he wants to test *Lambu Keyboard's* programming skills. He gave him this task: There are `n` buildings (numbered from left to right) with heights $H_1, H_2, \dots, H_n$. You can start jumping from any building. The rules of jumping are: 1. You can only jump to a building with lesser height than the height of the current building. 2. In the first turn, you can jump either way, and the 2 nd jump will be in the opposite direction of the previous jump and must end between the current index and the previous index. For example, if we start jumping from building 5, initially we can jump in either direction. Let's say we jump to building 8, then in the next jump, we can only jump in the left direction and only on buildings with indices 6, 7. Let's say we jump to building 6, then next time we can only jump in the right direction and between 6 and 8, i.e., to 7. We need to find the maximum number of jumps he can make, considering every building as the starting point. Input - First line contains an integer `n` i.e. the number of buildings. - Second line contains `n` space-separated integers denoting heights of buildings from 1 to `n`. Output One line containing `n` integers, the i th integer will denote the maximum possible number of jumps starting from the i th building. Constraints - $1 \leq n \leq 5000$ - $1 \leq H_1, H_2, \dots, H_n \leq 10000$ Sample Input 5 1 3 4 2 5 Sample Output 0 1 1 1 2 - If the starting building is with height 1, then you can't jump to any other building. - If the starting building is with height 3, then you can jump either to the building with height 2 on the right or with height 1 on the left. But there will be at most one jump. - If the starting building is with height 5, then one possible optimal sequence is to jump to the building with height 3, then to the building with height 2. So the maximum number of jumps is 2.
